definitions.face: Facial features only: face shape and parts, eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, nose, mouth and lips, facial skin and complexion, expression and gaze, and the hairline where it borders the face.
definitions.hair: Head hair only: hair color, length, cut and style, strands and texture, volume and flow, parting, and the hairline.
definitions.hands: Hands only: hand pose and gesture, fingers and knuckles, nails, palms, and accessories worn on the hands such as rings or gloves.
definitions.body: Whole-body physique and posture: build, proportions, pose and stance, limbs, body skin, and clothing as it covers the body.
definitions.upper_body: Upper body from roughly the waist up: face, hair, neck, shoulders, arms, chest and torso, upper-body skin, and the clothing worn on the upper body.
definitions.clothing: Worn garments and their materials only: garment types and layers, fabric and material, color and pattern, seams and stitching, folds and drape, and fastenings.
definitions.generic: The target object itself when it is not a person part: its shape and structure, material, surface texture and finish, color, and visible wear or damage.
